about: The one weekly close/open rule (docs/contracts/fx-and-market-week.md): markets that are not traded around the clock close Friday 17:00 America/New_York and reopen Sunday 17:00 America/New_York. That is 21:00 UTC while US daylight saving time is in force (2nd Sunday of March 07:00 UTC to 1st Sunday of November 06:00 UTC) and 22:00 UTC otherwise. Written by hand from the calendar, not generated. Pinned by lib/market-week.test.ts (web), engine/market-data gap_fill tests (engine) and tests/Vyx.Shared.Tests MarketWeekContractTests (terminal). Continuously traded symbols (crypto) are never closed by this rule.
